# Insights


Heidmar believes that trust and strong relationships come through hard work and transparency.


## HEIDMAR MARITIME HOLDINGS CORP. ANNOUNCES BOARD UPDATE


October 14, 2026


Athens / New York, 13 October 2026 –


Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. (the “Company” or “Heidmar”) (NASDAQ: HMR) announces that Andreas Konialidis has stepped down from the Company’s Board of Directors. The Board and management would like to sincerely thank Mr. Konialidis for his considerable contribution to the Company during his tenure and wish him all the best in his future endeavors.[Read More](https://www.heidmar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/HMR-Press-Release-AK-Resignation-October-2026-.pdf)
